title: Government Code, Title 21 (The CalSavers Retirement Savings Trust Act)
verified_how: The GOV code TOC shows 'TITLE 21. THE CALSAVERS RETIREMENT SAVINGS TRUST ACT [100000 - 100050]'. §100000 was amended by Stats. 2022, Ch. 192 (SB 1126), effective 1 Jan 2023.
notes: This Title was formerly called the California Secure Choice Retirement Savings Trust Act. The current title is CalSavers. It requires employers with no retirement plan to facilitate auto-enrolment IRAs. Social Security itself is federal.
